Training teams are quietly replacing filmed videos with AI presenters.

We tested the idea on Synthesia's free plan: typed one onboarding sentence, got back a presenter video. No camera, no studio, no actor. (Free plan adds a watermark.)

Where it makes sense:
→ Onboarding and SOP videos that change often (edit the text, re-render, no reshoot)
→ The same training in 140+ languages
→ Product walkthroughs for customer success

Where it doesn't: anything that needs real emotion or a real face from your team.

Starter is $29/mo ($18/mo billed yearly). Full breakdown of plans and limits in the first comment.
